The '''First Blood-Law of Evona''' was a set of rules and laws used by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] which governed guidance on matters relating to claiming revenge against an enemy. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era, the disgraced crime lord [[Voontara Fa'athra]] hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to extract vengeance in flesh against an [[Imperial Agent]] that ruined him.
